reply_text:
I've replied to Dana in the DM. Moss's notes mention two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers:

- **#4419**, from *Moss: North cheat sheet* (undated): gatehouse barcode scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags. The ticket was escalated to tier-2.
- **#PD-4492**, from *Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth* (5 Oct 2025): drivers at Doors 14–18 at the Eau Claire yard weren't getting SMS bay assignments. It was patched on 4 Oct, and Thea Ramaswell confirmed the fix on 5 Oct.

Moss wrote two other notes about this account, and neither has a ticket number. Moss's Central-team notes list #4409, #4412 and FR-882, but those belong to other accounts, so I left them out.

I also warned Dana that Marcus's own note from 14 Jul 2025 gives #4419 as Gate 3 printer lag, not scanners. Either the ticket covers two issues or one of the notes has it wrong, so it's worth checking before it goes in the weekly notes.

Moss's notes are public files in the team digest folders, so Dana could open them herself. I didn't use any channels or DMs she can't see.
